Definition: National Clinical Trial identifier, a unique identification number assigned to a clinical trial.
Label: NCT

Definition: A unique identifier assigned to a clinical trial publication in the PubMed database.
Label: PubMed ID

Definition: The title or identifier of the clinical trial being referred to in the study.
Label: Trial Name

Definition: The name of the person or people responsible for writing or publishing the clinical trial study.
Label: Author

Definition: The year in which the clinical trial was published.
Label: Year

Definition: Indicates whether the study results were fully published or only an abstract is available.
Label: Full Pub or Abstract

Definition: The stage or step in the clinical trial process, typically denoted by a Roman numeral (e.g. I, II, III, IV), which defines the scope, objectives, and duration of the trial.
Label: Phase

Definition: The designation of the clinical trial as either an original study or a follow-up study.
Label: Original/Follow Up

Definition: The total count of experimental treatment arms and control arms included in the clinical trial.
Label: Number of Arms Included

Definition: Name of the experimental arm or arms in the clinical trial.
Label: Treatment Arm(s)

Definition: The name of the arm in the clinical trial that does not receive the experimental treatment, serving as a comparison group.
Label: Control Arm

Column Name: Class of Agent in Treatment Arm 1
Definition: The type or category of therapeutic agent used in the first experimental arm of the clinical trial.

Definition: The specific treatment protocol or regimen used in the first experimental arm of the clinical trial.

Definition: The total number of participants included in the clinical trial.

Definition: The total number of participants included in the experimental arm of the clinical trial.
Label: Treatment Arm - N

Definition: The total number of participants included in the control arm of the clinical trial.

Definition: The median length of time, measured in months, that participants in the clinical trial were followed up or monitored after the start of the trial.

Definition: Median duration in months that participants in the treatment arm of the trial received on-treatment therapy.
Label: Median On-Treatment Duration (mo)

Definition: Median duration in months of participants receiving treatment in the control arm of the clinical trial.

Definition: Indicates whether the clinical trial reported results on the quality of life of participants.
Label: Quality of Life reported

Definition: A measure of the participants' overall well-being and satisfaction with their health status, as assessed through a standardized questionnaire or survey, reflecting their perceived quality of life during the clinical trial.
Label: Quality of Life Scale

Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | Synchronous
Definition: Indicates whether the results of the clinical trial were reported based on prognostic groups with synchronous metastases, where synchronous metastases refers to metastases present at the time of diagnosis of prostate cancer. with a response of either "yes" (Y) or "no" (N).
Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N

Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | Metachronous
Definition: Indicates whether the results of the clinical trial were reported based on prognostic groups of patients with metachronous diseases (diseases that occur at different times). with a response of either "yes" (Y) or "no" (N).
Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N

Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | High volume
Definition: Indicates whether the results of the clinical trial were reported based on prognostic groups with high volume/burden of metastases, with a response of either "yes" (Y) or "no" (N).
Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N

Column Name: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N | Low volume
Definition: Indicates whether the results were reported based on prognostic groups having a low volume of metastasis, with a yes or no response (Y/N).
Label: Reporting by prognostic groups - Y/N
